Check your claims before buyers do.

Your first sales are your most fragile. One dispute at 20 sales puts you at 5%, five times Whop's 1% limit.

Vouch checks your Whop listing before buyers do and keeps a dated record of what it said.

How it works:

  • Paste your listing link. Vouch reads the public page itself, so the record isn't something you typed.
  • It flags claims that often lead to disputes: income figures, guarantees, time promises, words like "always" and "never". Fix them, remove them, or attach a supporting file.
  • Vouch re-checks the page every day and saves each change as a new version.

Starter ($9/mo): 3 listings, full 180-day history, unlimited evidence packs, supporting files.

Vouch doesn't decide disputes or give legal advice.
